facts.fact: Held names not presented at the Shilak post by the thaw go to the assembly lockhouse; this is why Meera cannot wait out the thaw in Neshar and take summer roads.
Badami's big bell hangs on a peg by the stair in the Kothi Shilak salt house; Meera takes it down on returning, and sends Badami with Roop and Chand to Jassi's sister Leela's apricot orchard.
